description: Liam, 2026-11-05: automate the audits (napoleon docs/audits/AUDIT_2026-11-03.md, and the 2026-11-05 audit that found core CONSUMING.md in 32 of 38 job merges and napoleon at 12 ready rows with nothing building) so that he only answers questions (C41). A wsc audit verb (warscape/audit.py, warscape/verbs/audit.py) that computes the pipeline's metrics from git, the registries and, online, gh, compares them with [audit] thresholds and writes findings with stable ids to a dated record (docs/audits/AUDIT_<date>.json and .md with --record; _scratch/audits/ otherwise). Code only, no model in the loop. Host tests on synthetic repositories; calibrated on the core and on napoleon.
title: wsc audit: the pipeline measured, findings as data
